title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1989-10-08
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 analog-in > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC
source: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Mics on stand on the floor, near the soundboard

ai_review.summary: Fine audience recording captures a solid 10/8 show highlighted by a rare Help‑Slip‑Frank sequence.
ai_review.review: The tape, recorded with NAK shotgun mics and a Sony Pro‑D‑5 onto metal tape, is praised as a fine recording that presents the music clearly. The performance itself is described as a good show, with the Help > Slip > Franklin’s segment standing out as the high point. Overall reviewers find it worth an occasional listen despite being less celebrated than the following night.

ai_rating.rationale: High star rating and strong positive comments about both performance and recording, but only a single review limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with NAK shotgun mics, Sony Pro‑D‑5 cassette deck onto metal tape; reviewer calls it a fine recording with no major flaws noted.

standout_songs: Help on the Way > Slipknot! > Franklin's Tower
show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally solid show; highlighted by the rare Help‑Slip‑Frank sequence, making it a worthwhile listen despite being less heralded than 10/9.
